title: Staging Activation registry Recovery-only schema reconciliation

phases.objective: Restore the eight Activation registry tables required by Staging hard activation through the canonical Recovery-only schema-repair authority introduced by #8365, while keeping the corrective artifact outside the canonical ordered migration chain.

e2e_journeys.actor: Local Windows Staging recovery operator through the governed Recovery System surface
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: staging_recovery_schema_repair_prepare on the exact deployed main SHA with 20261003_staging_activation_registry_schema_reconciliation.sql.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The eight-table Activation corrective migration is Staging-only, checksum-bound, approval-gated and executed only through the shared single-use execution-ticket + verified local Windows/Docker handoff, with same-cycle schema readback before ticket finalization and no Production/provider mutation authority.
steps: Resolve the Activation corrective migration only from http-generic-api/staging-recovery-migrations and keep it outside http-generic-api/migrations.
Catalog the artifact as staging_recovery_only with eight CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statements targeting the runtime role.
Prepare schema repair through the shared server-derived staging_database_schema_repair authority and bind exact main deployment SHA plus Staging target fingerprint.
Require APPLY_STAGING_RUNTIME_MIGRATION:<sha>:staging-runtime:<migration> before issuing the single-use execution ticket.
Return only the verified local Windows/Docker handoff; never return the ticket signature, approval token, credentials, raw SQL or caller-selected database.
Rebuild and verify the Host Breakglass transport plan on the local Windows host before Docker/MariaDB mutation.
Verify all eight table postconditions in the same cycle and finalize the ticket only after canonical readback.
Keep activation_connector_pack_registry exposed through the admin-only connector pack Activation surface without seed/backfill rows.
Keep Production, Hostinger and provider mutation explicitly forbidden.
assertions: The corrective SQL exists only under staging-recovery-migrations and is absent from the canonical ordered migration root.
The migration contains exactly eight additive CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statements and no INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, REPLACE, ALTER, DROP, TRUNCATE, GRANT or REVOKE statement.
The Host Breakglass catalog records artifact_scope=staging_recovery_only, runtime role, exact checksum, exact statement count and eight postconditions.
The shared schema-repair prepare/approve path accepts this migration without adding a parallel Activation-specific mutation authority.
Approval yields the same verified local Windows/Docker handoff and single-use execution-ticket lifecycle used by the #8365 precedent.
Canonical schema-bundle ordering is unchanged by this corrective artifact.
The declaration is registered in Constitution.control_plane_paths and convergence.automation_control_paths.
Production mutation, provider mutation and secrets exposure remain false.

phases.objective: Production schema mutation and release promotion remain outside this Staging corrective repair.
blockers: Production requires a separate governed promotion and Production-authorized migration lifecycle.
This declaration grants no Production database, Hostinger, provider or deployment mutation authority.
